record.original_question: Is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subgroups of some Abelian group self-dual?

evidence.quote: [Wor2024b, quest. 3.80] Is the class of lattices that are isomorphic to a sublattice of the lattice of subgroups of some Abelian group self-dual?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a group $G$, let $\mathrm{Sub}(G)$ denote the lattice of all subgroups of $G$, ordered by inclusion. Let $\mathcal{A}$ be the class of all lattices $L$ such that $L$ is isomorphic to a sublattice of $\mathrm{Sub}(G)$ for some Abelian group $G$. Recall that the dual of a lattice $L = (L, \le)$ is the lattice $L^{\mathrm{op}} = (L, \ge)$ obtained by reversing the order, and a class $\mathcal{C}$ of lattices is called self-dual if $L \in \mathcal{C}$ implies $L^{\mathrm{op}} \in \mathcal{C}$.

Question: Is the class $\mathcal{A}$ self-dual? That is, whenever a lattice $L$ embeds as a sublattice into the subgroup lattice of some Abelian group, must its order-dual $L^{\mathrm{op}}$ also embed as a sublattice into the subgroup lattice of some (possibly different) Abelian group?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in a recent compilation of open problems on lattice combinatorics. While related results are known (e.g., the subgroup lattice of a finite abelian group is self-dual, and Baer/Zacher characterized groups with self-dual subgroup lattices), no resolution of the self-duality of the class of all sublattices of subgroup lattices of Abelian groups was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: Subgroup lattice and quotient lattice of finite abelian group are isomorphic
status_evidence.snippet: For finite abelian groups, the subgroup lattice is isomorphic to its dual via the quotient correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Self-duality holds for individual subgroup lattices of finite abelian groups, but the question concerns the class of all sublattices.

status_evidence.title: A characterization of subgroup lattices of finite Abelian groups
status_evidence.snippet: Characterization of subgroup lattices of finite abelian groups via modular lattice properties.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterization results exist but do not resolve the self-duality of the class of sublattices.
